cmake_minimum_required(VERSION 3.24)
project(forge_link LANGUAGES CXX)
find_package(bar CONFIG REQUIRED)
include(settings.cmake)
configure_file(public_config.h.in public_config.h @ONLY)
add_library(foo_static STATIC foo.cc)
add_library(foo_shared SHARED foo.cc)
set_target_properties(foo_static foo_shared PROPERTIES OUTPUT_NAME foo)
set_target_properties(foo_shared PROPERTIES VERSION 1.2.3 SOVERSION 1)
foreach(target foo_static foo_shared)
  target_include_directories(${target} PUBLIC "${CMAKE_CURRENT_SOURCE_DIR}" "${CMAKE_CURRENT_BINARY_DIR}")
  target_compile_definitions(${target} PUBLIC FOO_PUBLIC=1)
  target_link_libraries(${target} PUBLIC bar::bar)
endforeach()
install(TARGETS foo_static foo_shared ARCHIVE DESTINATION lib LIBRARY DESTINATION lib)
install(FILES foo.h "${CMAKE_CURRENT_BINARY_DIR}/public_config.h" DESTINATION include)
